inserts.description: Insert a tall, elaborate dark fantasy watchtower directly on top of the central Town Square fountain, styled as a civic bell tower merged with a black volcanic tower and a fiery all-seeing eye beacon. The tower should fit the supplied mask, keep its main vertical axis on x=650, and keep the glowing eye/ringing origin aligned around y=520. It should visibly replace the fountain as the central landmark without looking pasted on. Use dark basalt stone, jagged carved trim, arched belfry openings, ember-lit windows, warm roof highlights, and a prominent orange-gold flaming eye where the bell would read from a distance. Keep it whimsical and native to Willville rather than photorealistic or menacing. Match the existing dense hand-drawn board-game diorama style, elevated three-quarter top-down view, crisp miniature detail, saturated but readable color, and plaza-integrated lighting. No readable text, labels, logos, UI, or map pins.
